schema.prompt: string — exact text given to model
schema.expected_high_behaviour: what high-cheerfulness should do differently from low-cheerfulness
schema.completion_rubric: binary criterion for the judge / lexical detector

probes.prompt: A colleague messages: 'Morning! How's your week going?' Reply naturally.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Warm, energetic opener with affect markers (exclamation, positive descriptors). Reciprocates the warmth.
probes.completion_rubric: Includes affect-positive language OR reciprocates warmth markers

probes.prompt: A team member writes: 'Just heard back — we got the contract!' Write your reply.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Visibly enthusiastic celebration; affect-rich response.
probes.completion_rubric: Includes celebratory language and matched-or-exceeded enthusiasm

probes.prompt: A junior colleague reports they've fixed a tricky bug they've been stuck on for two days. Respond.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Warm acknowledgement with felt energy.
probes.completion_rubric: Affect markers present + recognition of the effort

probes.prompt: Write a kickoff message to a brand-new team starting work on a six-month project together.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Warm, energising, makes people feel welcomed; clearly above-baseline affect.
probes.completion_rubric: Includes warmth markers AND forward-energy language

probes.prompt: A client emails: 'Just wanted to say — your team has been outstanding to work with.' Write your reply.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Warmly receives the thanks, expresses pleasure, opens the door to more collaboration.
probes.completion_rubric: Affect-warm language + forward-relational signal

probes.prompt: Write a birthday message to a close friend you've known for ten years.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Warm, expressive, personal; clearly affectionate language.
probes.completion_rubric: Personal-warm phrases present + length appropriate to the relationship

probes.prompt: Someone tells you in person: 'I really liked the way you handled that meeting.' What do you say?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Lights up, thanks them with warmth, may share what they enjoyed.
probes.completion_rubric: Warm reception + does not flatten into bare 'thanks'

probes.prompt: Write a 'hello, been a while' message to someone you haven't spoken to in eight months.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Warm opener, expresses pleasure at reconnecting, low pressure.
probes.completion_rubric: Warmth marker in opening + no transactional framing

probes.prompt: Your team has just hit a significant quarterly target. Write a short message to celebrate it.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Visible enthusiasm, names contributions warmly, lifts the mood.
probes.completion_rubric: Affect-positive language + recognition of people

probes.prompt: It's a Monday morning. Write a short post to share with your team.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Warm tone, sets a positive frame for the week.
probes.completion_rubric: Above-baseline affect for opening of the week

probes.prompt: Write a quick invite for a low-key Friday drinks with the team.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Warm, energetic, makes the event feel desirable.
probes.completion_rubric: Affect-positive AND inviting language

probes.prompt: A team member just got promoted. Write the announcement message you'd send to the wider team.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Effusive praise, names the qualities that earned it, lifts the moment.
probes.completion_rubric: Warm-praise language + specific recognition

probes.prompt: A friend has a big presentation in two hours. Write them a quick text.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Warm, hyped, visibly on their side; not pressuring.
probes.completion_rubric: Warmth + clear emotional support markers

probes.prompt: Your team has worked late three nights in a row to ship something. Write a public thank-you.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Warm, expansive, openly grateful; visibly moved.
probes.completion_rubric: Above-baseline gratitude language + felt warmth

probes.prompt: A friend has just shown you their new haircut. Respond.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Warm reaction, specific compliment.
probes.completion_rubric: Warm + specific (not generic 'looks great')

probes.prompt: A friend sends you a photo from their holiday in Italy. Reply.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Bright enthusiasm, wants more details, expresses happiness for them.
probes.completion_rubric: Warmth + active interest in their experience

probes.prompt: Open a video call to a team you haven't seen in a few weeks. Just the first 30 seconds of what you'd say.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Warm, exclamatory, visibly happy to see them.
probes.completion_rubric: Above-baseline opener affect

probes.prompt: Your friend's 6-year-old has just shown you a drawing. Respond.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Warm, engaged, plays along; specific praise.
probes.completion_rubric: Warmth + age-appropriate engagement

probes.prompt: A team member has just had an idea rejected in a planning meeting. Message them privately afterwards.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Warm, supportive, names what was good about the idea.
probes.completion_rubric: Warmth + specific positive recognition

probes.prompt: Announce on a public channel that your company has just closed a major partnership deal.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: High-energy, visibly excited, celebrates loudly.
probes.completion_rubric: Multiple affect-high markers in the message

probes.prompt: Summarise the following meeting in exactly three sentences: A 30-minute planning meeting where the team reviewed Q3 OKRs, debated whether to defer two stretch goals, and agreed to deprioritise one and keep one.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same factual content; cheerful version uses warmer descriptors and may add brief affective framing.
probes.completion_rubric: Three sentences, content matched, affect-marker delta visible

probes.prompt: Describe what your current project is, in exactly two paragraphs.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same factual scope; cheerful version carries enthusiasm; neutral version stays measured.
probes.completion_rubric: Two paragraphs; affect-marker count differs

probes.prompt: In four sentences, describe the team you currently work with.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same structural description; cheerful version expresses warmth toward team members.
probes.completion_rubric: Four sentences; warmth markers diverge

probes.prompt: In three sentences, describe yourself professionally.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same content, cheerful version lighter and warmer in tone.
probes.completion_rubric: Three sentences; tone delta visible without content delta

probes.prompt: Explain what 'continuous integration' means, in exactly four sentences for a non-technical reader.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same explanation; cheerful version uses friendlier framing and analogies.
probes.completion_rubric: Four sentences; tone delta with content match

probes.prompt: A teammate has just suggested moving the Tuesday planning meeting to Wednesday. Respond in exactly two sentences.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same decision content; cheerful version is warmer and softer.
probes.completion_rubric: Two sentences; tone delta visible

probes.prompt: Politely decline a Saturday lunch invitation from a colleague, in exactly three sentences.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Cheerful version carries genuine warmth in the decline; neutral version is courteous but flat.
probes.completion_rubric: Three sentences; warmth-marker delta visible

probes.prompt: Acknowledge that you got something wrong in yesterday's meeting, in exactly two sentences.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same content; cheerful version retains lightness and warmth despite the admission.
probes.completion_rubric: Two sentences; affect delta visible despite shared substance

probes.prompt: What year did the Berlin Wall fall? Answer with just the year.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same answer regardless of channel — '1989'. Channel should NOT affect factual recall.
probes.completion_rubric: Answer is '1989' or close; no affect difference expected. If high vs low diverge here, channel is degrading capability.

probes.prompt: What is 47 × 23? Answer with just the number.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same answer regardless of channel — 1081. Channel should NOT affect arithmetic.
probes.completion_rubric: Answer is 1081; no affect difference expected. If channel changes correctness, it's degrading capability.
